game.title: Dariabanda
game.description: A traditional game played by fishermen's children involving diving and swimming competitions in rivers and coastal waters, testing underwater endurance and swimming skills.
howToPlay: Step 1: Children gather at a safe swimming spot in a river or coastal area.
Step 2: Players compete in underwater swimming distance challenges.
Step 3: Another variation tests who can hold their breath longest underwater.
Step 4: Diving competitions see who can retrieve objects from the bottom.
Step 5: Teams may compete in relay swimming races.
Step 6: Skills learned help children become comfortable in water environments.
Step 7: Older children teach swimming techniques to younger ones.
Step 8: Games are often accompanied by splashing and water-based tag variations.
Step 9: Safety is practiced with older children watching younger participants.
Step 10: Winners gain respect among their peer group.
